words.gloss: the one to be marched against
the one about to be marched upon
words.gram: m. nom. sg. fut. pass. part. abhi-√yā

hindi: जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो, जिस पर चढ़ाई होने वाली है, सन्धि के कारण को ग्रहण करने की इच्छा वाला अथवा नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला, सामवायिकों में से किसी एक से दुगुने लाभ पर सौदा करे।
english: The one to be marched against [or] the one about to be marched upon, wishing either to take up or to destroy the cause of peace, should strike a bargain with any one of the associates for double the gain.
notes: Subject: yātavyaḥ and abhiyāsyamānaḥ stand side by side with no vā; '[or]' is supplied in English only. 'sandhi-kāraṇam ādātu-kāmaḥ' is literal (wishing to take up / to destroy the cause of peace). sāmavāyika = member of a samavāya (association), rendered 'associate' as in 7.4 and 7.9. paṇeta from √paṇ 'bargain, stake'; sandhi = peace as in Books 8-9.
lines_deva: यातव्यो ऽभियास्यमानः सन्धि.कारणम् आदातु.कामो विहन्तु.कामो वा सामवायिकानाम् अन्यतमं लाभ.द्वैगुण्येन पणेत
lines_iast: yātavyo 'bhiyāsyamānaḥ sandhi.kāraṇam ādātu.kāmo vihantu.kāmo vā sāmavāyikānām anyatamaṃ lābha.dvaiguṇyena paṇeta

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √paṇ

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences from home, obstacles, benefits to others, bodily harms

hindi: सौदा करने वाला इसके क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, बाधा, दूसरों के उपकार और शरीर की पीड़ाओं का वर्णन करे।
english: The one bargaining should describe his losses, expenditures, absences from home, obstacles, benefits to others and bodily harms.
notes: ca closes the dvandva list ('...bodily harms and'); asya taken as 'his' (the one bargained with, or the bargainer: ambiguous). pratyavāya = setback (also 'hindrance, sin'); para-upakāra = benefit to others (alt. 'help from others'); ābādhā = harm, affliction.
lines_deva: पणमानः क्षय.व्यय.प्रवास.प्रत्यवाय.पर.उपकार.शरीर.आबाधांश् च-अस्य वर्णयेत्
lines_iast: paṇamānaḥ kṣaya.vyaya.pravāsa.pratyavāya.para.upakāra.śarīra.ābādhāṃś ca-asya varṇayet

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. prati-√pad

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले को अर्थ से जोड़े।
english: [He] should unite the one who has accepted with gain.
notes: artha rendered 'gain' (9.7 line of the glossary); alternative 'wealth' or 'object'. Object/subject unstated.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नम् अर्थेन योजयेत्
lines_iast: pratipannam arthena yojayet

hindi: अथवा दूसरों से वैर पकड़वाकर विसंवाद कराए।
english: Or, having caused enmity to be seized by the others, [he] should cause [him] to disagree.
notes: visaṃvādayet: literal 'cause to disagree / contradict'; alternatives 'make break his word', 'cause to be deceived'. grāhayitvā literal 'having caused to be seized' (glossary 9.6); the sense 'made to adopt' is possible. pare = the others, not 'enemies'.
lines_deva: वैरं वा परैर् ग्राहयित्वा विसंवादयेत्
lines_iast: vairaṃ vā parair grāhayitvā visaṃvādayet

words.gloss: one whose action is badly begun

words.gram: f. acc. sg. past part. ā-√rabh; agrees with siddhim

words.gloss: allied with the one to be marched against
in difficulty over an immediate object

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. a-vi-√śvas

hindi: बुरी तरह आरम्भ किए कर्म वाले को अधिक क्षय और व्यय से जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, अथवा भली-भाँति आरम्भ की हुई यात्रा की सिद्धि को नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला, मूल पर अथवा यात्रा पर प्रहार करने की इच्छा वाला, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो उससे मिला हुआ, फिर माँगने की इच्छा वाला, वर्तमान अर्थ में कठिनाई वाला, अथवा उसमें अविश्वास करने वाला, वर्तमान में थोड़ा लाभ चाहे, भविष्य में बहुत।
english: [One] wishing to connect one whose action is badly begun with more loss and expenditure, or wishing to thwart the well begun success of the expedition, wishing to strike at the base or at the expedition, allied with the one to be marched against, wishing to ask again, in difficulty over an immediate object, or distrustful of him, should desire a small gain in the present, a great one in the future.
notes: One long list of nominative adjectives with no finite verb until icchet; the commas are the translator's. 'sv.ārabdhāṃ' read su-ārabdhām (su+ā > svā, in contrast with dur-ārabdha at the start); alternative sva-ārabdhām 'begun by himself'. Whose expedition is meant (the other's) is not stated. bhūyaḥ 'further/more'. artha in pratyutpanna-artha-kṛcchra taken as 'object' (alt. 'need', 'wealth'). yoktu-kāmaḥ with instrumental: wishing to burden/join with loss and expenditure.
lines_deva: दुरारब्ध.कर्माणं भूयः क्षय.व्ययाभ्यां योक्तु.कामः स्व्.आरब्धां वा यात्रा.सिद्धिं विघातयितु.कामो मूले यात्रायां वा प्रहर्तु.कामो यातव्य.संहितः पुनर् याचितु.कामः प्रत्युत्पन्न.अर्थ.कृच्छ्रस् तस्मिन्न् अविश्वस्तो वा तदात्वे लाभम् अल्पम् इच्छेत्, आयत्यां प्रभूतम्
lines_iast: durārabdha.karmāṇaṃ bhūyaḥ kṣaya.vyayābhyāṃ yoktu.kāmaḥ sv.ārabdhāṃ vā yātrā.siddhiṃ vighātayitu.kāmo mūle yātrāyāṃ vā prahartu.kāmo yātavya.saṃhitaḥ punar yācitu.kāmaḥ pratyutpanna.artha.kṛcchras tasminn aviśvasto vā tadātve lābham alpam icchet, āyatyāṃ prabhūtam

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ava-√īkṣ

hindi: मित्र के उपकार, शत्रु के उपघात, अर्थ के अनुबन्ध को देखता हुआ, पहले उपकार करने वाले को अधिक कराने की इच्छा वाला, वर्तमान में बड़ा लाभ छोड़कर भविष्य में थोड़ा चाहे।
english: Looking to the benefit to an ally, the injury to an enemy, [and] the sequel of gain, wishing to cause the earlier benefactor [to act] more, [one] should, having given up a great gain in the present, desire a small one in the future.
notes: kārayitu-kāmaḥ has no stated object of the action (what the benefactor is to do is not said); bhūyaḥ taken as 'further'. artha-anubandha: anubandha = sequel (9.7). The three accusatives are a list with no ca; '[and]' in English only.
lines_deva: मित्र.उपकारम् अमित्र.उपघातम् अर्थ.अनुबन्धम् अवेक्षमाणः पूर्व.उपकारकं कारयितु.कामो भूयस् तदात्वे महान्तं लाभम् उत्सृज्य-आयत्याम् अल्पम् इच्छेत्
lines_iast: mitra.upakāram amitra.upaghātam artha.anubandham avekṣamāṇaḥ pūrva.upakārakaṃ kārayitu.kāmo bhūyas tadātve mahāntaṃ lābham utsṛjya-āyatyām alpam icchet

words.gloss: by the treasonable and the enemy
by a taker of the base

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. vi-√grah

hindi: दूष्य और शत्रु से, मूल हरने वाले से अथवा श्रेष्ठ से आक्रान्त की रक्षा करने की इच्छा वाला, वैसा उपकार कराने की इच्छा वाला, अथवा सम्बन्ध को देखने वाला, वर्तमान में और भविष्य में लाभ स्वीकार न करे।
english: Wishing to protect one attacked by the treasonable and the enemy, by a taker of the base or by the superior, wishing to have such a benefit done, or looking to the relationship, [one] should not accept gain, both in the present and in the future.
notes: mūla-hara literal 'taker of the base' (as 7.2); no sense imported. vigṛhīta 'attacked, set at war with'. The first member pair has no vā; vā stands once after mūla-hareṇa. 'tadātve ca āyatyāṃ ca' = both ... and.
lines_deva: दूष्य.अमित्राभ्यां मूल.हरेण वा ज्यायसा विगृहीतं त्रातु.कामस् तथा.विधम् उपकारं कारयितु.कामः सम्बन्ध.अवेक्षी वा तदात्वे च-आयत्यां च लाभं न प्रतिगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: dūṣya.amitrābhyāṃ mūla.hareṇa vā jyāyasā vigṛhītaṃ trātu.kāmas tathā.vidham upakāraṃ kārayitu.kāmaḥ sambandha.avekṣī vā tadātve ca-āyatyāṃ ca lābhaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: breaking up of the peace of ally and enemy

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √śaṅk
m. acc. sg. past part. a-pra-√āp

hindi: सन्धि कर चुका हुआ, उल्लंघन करने की इच्छा वाला, दूसरे की प्रकृतियों को क्षीण करने अथवा मित्र और शत्रु की सन्धि को तोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, दूसरे के आक्रमण से शंका करता हुआ, न प्राप्त हुआ लाभ अथवा अधिक माँगे।
english: One who has made peace, wishing to transgress [it], [or] wishing to weaken the other's constituent elements or to break up the peace of ally and enemy, suspecting attack from the other, should ask for a gain not yet obtained, or more.
notes: '[or]' is supplied in English only. mitra-amitra-sandhi-viśleṣaṇa: literally the breaking of the peace(s) of ally and enemy; Kangle-style 'alliances with friends and enemies' is an alternative. para-abhiyoga taken as attack by the other (alt. accusation). 'lābham aprāptam adhikaṃ vā': 'a gain not yet obtained, or more'.
lines_deva: कृत.सन्धिर् अतिक्रमितु.कामः परस्य प्रकृति.कर्शनं मित्र.अमित्र.सन्धि.विश्लेषणं वा कर्तु.कामः पर.अभियोगात्-शङ्कमानो लाभम् अप्राप्तम् अधिकं वा याचेत
lines_iast: kṛta.sandhir atikramitu.kāmaḥ parasya prakṛti.karśanaṃ mitra.amitra.sandhi.viśleṣaṇaṃ vā kartu.kāmaḥ para.abhiyogāt-śaṅkamāno lābham aprāptam adhikaṃ vā yāceta

hindi: दूसरा उसे वर्तमान में और भविष्य में क्रम को देखे।
english: The other should look to him, [and] to the sequence, both in the present and in the future.
notes: Syntax uncertain: tam (acc.) and kramam (acc.) both depend on avekṣeta; the sense may be 'the other should look to the sequence [of events] regarding him'. '[and]' supplied in English only. krama = sequence/course/order.
lines_deva: तम् इतरस् तदात्वे च-आयत्यां च क्रमम् अवेक्षेत
lines_iast: tam itaras tadātve ca-āyatyāṃ ca kramam avekṣeta

words.gram: m. nom. pl. past part. vi-ā-√khyā

hindi: इससे पूर्व वालों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the earlier [ones] are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ'; pūrve = the earlier (cases), no noun stated.
lines_deva: तेन पूर्वे व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: tena pūrve vyākhyātāḥ

words.gloss: of the enemy and the conqueror

words.gram: m. gen. du. pres. part. anu-√grah

words.gloss: from [allies] undertaking the feasible, the fit, the auspicious, steady in action, with devoted constituent elements

hindi: किन्तु शत्रु और विजिगीषु के अपने-अपने मित्र पर अनुग्रह करने पर शक्य, कल्य, भव्य का आरम्भ करने वाले, स्थिर कर्म वाले, अनुरक्त प्रकृति वालों से भेद।
english: But, when the enemy and the conqueror each favour his own ally, the difference [comes] from [those] who undertake the feasible, the fit, the auspicious, who are steady in action, [and] whose constituent elements are devoted.
notes: The long compound is a dvandva of five types: śakya-ārambhin, kalya-ārambhin, bhavya-ārambhin, sthira-karman, anurakta-prakṛti (ārambhi is shared by the first three); units 12-14 explain them in turn. Genitive dual with participle read as a genitive absolute ('when ... favour'). Predicate of viśeṣaḥ unstated. kalya 'fit' (alt. 'sound, ready'); bhavya 'auspicious' (alt. 'prosperous'). prakṛti here = constituent elements (alt. 'nature').
lines_deva: अरि.विजिगीष्वोस् तु स्वं स्वं मित्रम् अनुगृह्णतोः शक्य.कल्य.भव्य.आरम्भि.स्थिर.कर्म.अनुरक्त.प्रकृतिभ्यो विशेषः
lines_iast: ari.vijigīṣvos tu svaṃ svaṃ mitram anugṛhṇatoḥ śakya.kalya.bhavya.ārambhi.sthira.karma.anurakta.prakṛtibhyo viśeṣaḥ

hindi: शक्य का आरम्भ करने वाला सहने योग्य कर्म आरम्भ करता है, कल्य का आरम्भ करने वाला निर्दोष, भव्य का आरम्भ करने वाला कल्याण-उदय वाला।
english: The undertaker of the feasible undertakes manageable action; the undertaker of the fit, [action that is] faultless; the undertaker of the auspicious, [action that has] an auspicious outcome.
notes: In the second and third clauses karma and ārabhate are understood; English brackets only. viṣahya 'manageable' (that can be borne). udaya 'rise, outcome'.
lines_deva: शक्य.आरम्भी विषह्यं कर्म-आरभते, कल्य.आरम्भी निर्दोषम्, भव्य.आरम्भी कल्याण.उदयम्
lines_iast: śakya.ārambhī viṣahyaṃ karma-ārabhate, kalya.ārambhī nirdoṣam, bhavya.ārambhī kalyāṇa.udayam

hindi: स्थिर कर्म वाला पूरा किए बिना कर्म से विराम नहीं लेता।
english: One steady in action does not stop action without completing [it].
notes: na ... asamāpya: 'not (stop) without having completed'; karma taken as the object of uparamate (alt. ablative-like 'from action').
lines_deva: स्थिर.कर्मा न-असमाप्य कर्म-उपरमते
lines_iast: sthira.karmā na-asamāpya karma-uparamate

words.gloss: one whose constituent elements are devoted

hindi: अनुरक्त प्रकृति वाला अच्छे सहायकों के होने से थोड़े अनुग्रह से भी कार्य सिद्ध करता है।
english: One whose constituent elements are devoted accomplishes the task even with a small favour, because of having good helpers.
lines_deva: अनुरक्त.प्रकृतिः सुसहायत्वाद् अल्पेन-अप्य् अनुग्रहेण कार्यं साधयति
lines_iast: anurakta.prakṛtiḥ susahāyatvād alpena-apy anugraheṇa kāryaṃ sādhayati

hindi: वे ये कृतार्थ सुख से और बहुत उपकार करते हैं।
english: Those, these, their purpose accomplished, help easily and greatly.
notes: 'te ete' (written ta ete) = 'those, these', both rendered. The referent (the allies of the types in units 11-14) is not stated. sukhena 'easily' (alt. 'happily').
lines_deva: त एते कृत.अर्थाः सुखेन प्रभूतं च-उपकुर्वन्ति
lines_iast: ta ete kṛta.arthāḥ sukhena prabhūtaṃ ca-upakurvanti

hindi: अतः विपरीत अनुग्रह किए जाने योग्य नहीं।
english: Therefore the contrary [ones] are not to be favoured.
notes: pratiloma 'contrary' (literally 'against the grain'); it is not the caste sense of Book 3. The contrary ones are the opposites of the types in units 11-14.
lines_deva: अतः प्रतिलोमा न-अनुग्राह्याः
lines_iast: ataḥ pratilomā na-anugrāhyāḥ

words.gloss: in the favouring of one person

hindi: उन दोनों के एक पुरुष पर अनुग्रह करने में जो मित्र पर अथवा मित्रतर पर अनुग्रह करता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of those two, in the favouring of one person, he who favours an ally or a closer ally outwits.

text_flags.why: possible stray compound dot: -tara is a comparative suffix, not a member; unit 20 prints mitrataraṃ

notes: 'in the favouring of one person' = when the two favour the same person (the object of unit 11's allies); sense of the unit: the one who favours an ally or closer ally outwits the other. mitra-tara 'closer ally' (literally 'more of an ally').
lines_deva: तयोर् एक.पुरुष.अनुग्रहे यो मित्रं मित्र.तरं वा-अनुगृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: tayor eka.puruṣa.anugrahe yo mitraṃ mitra.taraṃ vā-anugṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences from home, benefits to others

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र से स्वयं की वृद्धि प्राप्त करता है, दूसरा क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, दूसरों के उपकारों को।
english: For [one] obtains growth of himself from an ally; the other, [obtains] losses, expenditures, absences from home, [and] benefits to others.
notes: The verb is not repeated for itaraḥ; English supplies '[obtains]' in brackets, Hindi leaves the clause open. Subject of prāpnoti unstated. ātma = self.
lines_deva: मित्राद् आत्म.वृद्धिं हि प्राप्नोति, क्षय.व्यय.प्रवास.पर.उपकारान् इतरः
lines_iast: mitrād ātma.vṛddhiṃ hi prāpnoti, kṣaya.vyaya.pravāsa.para.upakārān itaraḥ

hindi: और कृतार्थ शत्रु प्रतिकूलता को जाता है।
english: And an enemy whose purpose is accomplished goes to hostility.
notes: vaiguṇya literal 'lack of good qualities / deficiency'; rendered 'hostility' with viguṇa = hostile (11.1 glossary line); see unit 22.
lines_deva: कृत.अर्थश् च शत्रुर् वैगुण्यम् एति
lines_iast: kṛta.arthaś ca śatrur vaiguṇyam eti

words.gram: m. gen. du. pres. part. anu-√grah

hindi: किन्तु मध्यम पर अनुग्रह करने वाले दोनों में से जो मध्यम पर, मित्र पर अथवा मित्रतर पर अनुग्रह करता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: But of the two favouring the middle king, he who favours the middle king, an ally or a closer ally, outwits.
notes: Ambiguity: 'yo madhyamaṃ mitraṃ mitrataraṃ vā' may mean 'who favours the middle king, [being] an ally or a closer ally' (as rendered) or 'who favours the middle king's ally or closer ally'. Parallel to unit 17.
lines_deva: मध्यमं त्व् अनुगृह्णतोर् यो मध्यमं मित्रं मित्रतरं वा-अनुगृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: madhyamaṃ tv anugṛhṇator yo madhyamaṃ mitraṃ mitrataraṃ vā-anugṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: losses, expenditures, absences from home, benefits to others

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र से स्वयं की वृद्धि प्राप्त करता है, दूसरा क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास, दूसरों के उपकारों को।
english: For [one] obtains growth of himself from an ally; the other, [obtains] losses, expenditures, absences from home, [and] benefits to others.
notes: Identical to unit 18 in the e-text (repeated line, as in the edition). The verb is not repeated for itaraḥ; English supplies '[obtains]' in brackets.

english: For [he] obtains the middle-enemy, one who has made effort, withdrawn, [and] gone to a single object.

lines_deva: कृत.प्रयासं हि मध्यम.अमित्रम् अपसृतम् एक.अर्थ.उपगतं प्राप्नोति

in the giving of a share of the army

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. anu-√rañj

hindi: मध्यम और उदासीन को सेना का अंश देने में जो शूर, अस्त्र में प्रशिक्षित, कष्ट सहने वाली अथवा अनुरक्त सेना देता है, वह छला जाता है।
english: In the giving of a share of the army to the middle and the neutral king, he who gives an army that is brave, trained in arms, enduring hardship, or devoted, is outwitted.
notes: daṇḍa here = army (Books 8/9 glossary lines). kṛta-astra literally 'whose weapons are made'; the usual sense 'trained in arms' is used (medium). The gen. dual madhyama-udāsīnayoḥ is read with dāne ('to'). The adjectives agree with daṇḍam (m.); vā closes the list.
lines_deva: मध्यम.उदासीनयोर् बल.अंश.दाने यः शूरं कृत.अस्त्रं दुःख.सहम् अनुरक्तं वा दण्डं ददाति सो ऽतिसन्धीयते
lines_iast: madhyama.udāsīnayor bala.aṃśa.dāne yaḥ śūraṃ kṛta.astraṃ duḥkha.saham anuraktaṃ vā daṇḍaṃ dadāti so 'tisandhīyate

hindi: विपरीत छल लेता है।
english: The opposite one outwits.
notes: 'The opposite' = he who gives an army not of the kinds listed in unit 25; the noun is not stated.
lines_deva: विपरीतो ऽतिसन्धत्ते

words.gloss: of the hereditary, hired, guild, ally and forest-tribe troops
whose place and time are ascertained
whose place and time are separated

hindi: किन्तु जहाँ भेजी गई सेना उसे अथवा, और, अर्थ को और दूसरों को सिद्ध करती है, वहाँ मौल, भृत, श्रेणी, मित्र, आटवी सेनाओं में से किसी एक, ज्ञात देश और काल वाली सेना दे, अथवा व्यवहित देश और काल वाली शत्रु और आटवी सेना।
english: But where the army sent out accomplishes him or—and—the object and others, there [one] should give an army, any one of the hereditary, hired, guild, ally and forest-tribe troops, whose place and time are ascertained, or enemy and forest-tribe troops whose place and time are separated.

text_flags.why: possible stray vā before ca-artham in the first clause (vā and ca both follow tam); the second vā of the line is sound

notes: 'taṃ vā ca-artham anyāṃś ca' has both vā and ca after tam; the grammar is doubtful (probably taṃ ca-artham anyāṃś ca, 'him, the object and others'); both particles are rendered literally as printed. 'tam' (him) = the recipient of the army. daṇḍa = army (Book 9 glossary). Troops: hereditary/hired/guild/ally/forest-tribe (9.2). upalabdha-deśa-kāla 'of ascertained place and time'; vyavahita 'separated, intervening' (alt. 'distant'). amitra-aṭavī-bala read as a dvandva (enemy troops and forest-tribe troops). dadyāt governs both objects. Alternative reading: tam agrees with artham ('that object'), giving 'accomplishes that object and others'; the vā is then stray. The Hindi/English 'him or—and—' follows the printed particles literally.
lines_deva: यत्र तु दण्डः प्रहितस् तं वा च-अर्थम् अन्यांश् च साधयति तत्र मौल.भृत.श्रेणी.मित्र.अटवी.बलानाम् अन्यतमम् उपलब्ध.देश.कालं दण्डं दद्यात्, अमित्र.अटवी.बलं वा व्यवहित.देश.कालम्
lines_iast: yatra tu daṇḍaḥ prahitas taṃ vā ca-artham anyāṃś ca sādhayati tatra maula.bhṛta.śreṇī.mitra.aṭavī.balānām anyatamam upalabdha.deśa.kālaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt, amitra.aṭavī.balaṃ vā vyavahita.deśa.kālam

words.gloss: among enemies, in forests, on unsuitable ground, out of season
on the pretext of the army's engagement

hindi: किन्तु जिसके विषय में सोचे—“कृतार्थ मेरी सेना को ले ले, अथवा शत्रु, वन, अनुपयुक्त भूमि, बेमौसम में बसा दे, अथवा निष्फल कर दे”—उस पर सेना के व्यासङ्ग के बहाने अनुग्रह न करे।
english: But [him] whom [one] might think, “One whose purpose is accomplished might take my army, or lodge [it] among enemies, in forests, on unsuitable ground and out of season, or make [it] fruitless,” him [one] should not favour, on the pretext of the army's engagement.
notes: Quotation closed by iti (carried by the quotation marks, glossed 'closing particle'). The locative compound is read as a dvandva of four (enemies, forests, unsuitable ground, out of season); 'among enemies' may also be 'in enemy [territory]'. vyāsaṅga = engagement/entanglement (alt. 'being engaged elsewhere'). The object 'it' (the army) is supplied in brackets in English. gṛhṇīyāt 'take' (alt. 'keep').
lines_deva: यं तु मन्येत "कृत.अर्थो मे दण्डं गृह्णीयाद्, अमित्र.अटव्य्.अभूम्य्.अनृतुषु वा वासयेद्, अफलं वा कुर्याद्" इति, दण्ड.व्यासङ्ग.अपदेशेन न-एनम् अनुगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: yaṃ tu manyeta "kṛta.artho me daṇḍaṃ gṛhṇīyād, amitra.aṭavy.abhūmy.anṛtuṣu vā vāsayed, aphalaṃ vā kuryād" iti, daṇḍa.vyāsaṅga.apadeśena na-enam anugṛhṇīyāt

hindi: इस प्रकार किन्तु अवश्य अनुग्रह किए जाने योग्य होने पर उसे उस काल को सहने वाली सेना दे।
english: But in this way, when [he] is necessarily to be favoured, [one] should give him an army able to bear that time.
notes: anugrahītavye is a locative gerundive ('when to be favoured'), subject unstated; tat-kāla-saha 'able to bear that time' (alt. 'for that time only').
lines_deva: एवम् अवश्यं त्व् अनुग्रहीतव्ये तत्.काल.सहम् अस्मै दण्डं दद्यात्
lines_iast: evam avaśyaṃ tv anugrahītavye tat.kāla.saham asmai daṇḍaṃ dadyāt

hindi: और समाप्ति तक इसे बसाए और लड़ाए, और सेना के व्यसनों से रक्षा करे।
english: And until completion [one] should lodge him and make [him] fight, and should protect [him] from calamities of the army.
notes: Three ca: after ā-samāpteḥ, after yodhayet and after bala-vyasanebhyaḥ, all rendered 'and'.
lines_deva: आ.समाप्तेश् च-एनं वासयेद् योधयेच् च बल.व्यसनेभ्यश् च रक्षेत्
lines_iast: ā.samāpteś ca-enaṃ vāsayed yodhayec ca bala.vyasanebhyaś ca rakṣet

words.gloss: from one whose purpose is accomplished

hindi: और कृतार्थ से बहाने सहित अपस्रावित कराए।
english: And [one] should cause [him] to flow away, with a pretext, from [the one] whose purpose is accomplished.
notes: apasrāvayet literally 'cause to flow away'; the sense of the object (him / the army) is not stated and is bracketed in English only. kṛta-arthāt may be an ablative of separation ('from') or 'when his purpose is done'.
lines_deva: कृत.अर्थाच् च स.अपदेशम् अपस्रावयेत्
lines_iast: kṛta.arthāc ca sa.apadeśam apasrāvayet

english: Or [one] should give him an army of the treasonable, the enemy and forest tribes.

lines_deva: दूष्य.अमित्र.अटवी.दण्डं वा-अस्मै दद्यात्
lines_iast: dūṣya.amitra.aṭavī.daṇḍaṃ vā-asmai dadyāt

english: Or, having made peace with the one to be marched against, [one] should outwit him.

words.gloss: of the equal, the inferior and the superior

hindi: क्योंकि समान लाभ में सन्धि हो, विषम में आक्रमण माना गया है; ये सम, हीन, विशिष्ट के कहे गए सन्धि और आक्रमण हैं।
english: For in an equal gain there should be peace; in an unequal [one], attack is deemed. Such are the peace and attacks stated for the equal, the inferior and the superior.
notes: Verse (two half-lines). The closing 'ity uktāḥ sandhi-vikramāḥ' is a summing-up line, rendered 'Such are ...' (glossary), iti glossed 'closing particle'. viṣame: the noun lābhe is understood. vikrama = attack (alt. 'prowess, valour').
lines_deva: समे हि लाभे सन्धिः स्याद् विषमे विक्रमो मतः
सम.हीन.विशिष्टानाम् इत्य् उक्ताः सन्धि.विक्रमाः
